title: BanglaRhet: Benchmarking Classical and Transformer Models for Rhetorical and Persuasion Detection in Bangla Political Speech
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark for detecting rhetorical and persuasion techniques in Bangla political speech. Although one of the target detection categories is 'Moral Appeal', the paper focuses on classifying linguistic and political text strategies rather than evaluating the moral reasoning, ethical frameworks, or religious knowledge of the language models themselves.
